name: cricket-auction
description: Cricket tournament auction system. NPM IS A DEVELOPER CONVENIENCE FOR CLASP ONLY. The application itself has ZERO runtime dependencies and NO build step: the backend is Google Apps Script (.gs in backend/) and the frontend is static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS (frontend/) served by GitHub Pages exactly as committed. Node never runs in production.
_readme: Do not add a bundler, a transpiler, a framework, or any runtime dependency.
backend/*.gs is Apps Script, not Node: no require, no import, no npm packages.
frontend/ must stay servable as plain static files from GitHub Pages.
The only reason this file exists is to pin clasp and hold four shortcuts.
Usage: npm run deploy -- <deploymentId>. Get the id from 'npx clasp deployments'.
Use the SAME deploymentId every time - a new deployment means a NEW /exec
URL and the frontend keeps calling the old code. See RUNBOOK.md Part 2.
There is no 'npm test'. Tests run in the Apps Script editor via
runAllTests(), and only against a sheet whose Config env key is TEST.
